text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, sorry about that. I was in the 
zone.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Yes. I think so too, sir!
choice_data_list: そっか。上手く集中できてるのかも
choice_data_list_en: I see. Maybe they're just really dialed in.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Usually, I'd feel... a bit more pressure, 
I guess. Like I have to be the star of the 
show, but...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"Maybe it's because of everything I've 
built up to this day... All I have left in 
me is the desire not to give an inch."

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"Please watch, Trainer-san. —I'm going to 
do this."
